origin.description: Reverse dependencies from an installed-package table.
origin.usage: dependsOnPkgs(pkgs, dependencies = "strong", recursive = TRUE, lib.loc = NULL, installed)

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: strong, most, all, or field names.

arguments.name: installed
arguments.text: Package table with Package and dependency fields.

origin.details: Recursive search follows the packages that were found. The package itself is not in the result.
origin.example:
m <- matrix(c("a", "b", NA, NA, NA, NA), nrow=1)
colnames(m) <- c("Package","Depends","Imports","LinkingTo","Suggests","Enhances")
cat(paste(dependsOnPkgs("b", installed=m), collapse=","), "\n")

translation.description: Reverse dependencies from an installed-package table.

from tools.deps import depends_on_pkgs
